events.evidence: The International Criminal Court issues an arrest warrant for Russian president Vladimir Putin
New Zealand bans the use of Chinese-owned video sharing app TikTok on all government devices
Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announces that Turkey will begin the process of ratifying Finland's membership of NATO without Sweden

label.note: ICC warrant for Putin and TikTok ban raise geopolitical risk; Finland NATO progress is supportive.
